newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended weaker versus the dollar on the inter-bank forex market as the U.S. unit surged in late European trade, dealers said.
The forint closed at the central bank bid of 164.88/93 to the dollar, compared to an opening level of 164.63/68.
"The forint followed the dollar/mark cross which came on strong before the close," said Zsolt Tilimon of Citibank.

The currency futures market of the Budapest Commodities Exchange saw modest 3.26 billion forint turnover, dominated for the third day running by the Swiss franc which rose for most contracts. -- Budapest newsroom +361 327 4040
